explanation.headline: Nothing to verify: no rules were checked
explanation.summary: Verus was given no rules (the spec and verdicts lists are empty), so nothing was proved or rejected. The robot's code does nothing every turn: no firing, driving or turning. Neither the open arena nor the city battle recorded any violations, but with no rules checked that says little.
